🔍 WHAT IS STELLAR (XLM)
————————————————————————

Stellar is not just another payments blockchain — and that distinction matters more than most crypto investors realize. Built on the Stellar Consensus Protocol (SCP), Stellar offers near-instant settlement, fees of a fraction of a cent, and a compliance-ready architecture that traditional financial institutions actually trust. With finality in 3–5 seconds and native support for multi-currency transactions, Stellar has quietly positioned itself as the go-to rails for cross-border money movement.

The Stellar Development Foundation is the backbone of the project — a non-profit overseeing one of the most institutionally connected networks in crypto. IBM built its entire World Wire cross-border payment system on Stellar. MoneyGram integrated it for real-time settlement. Franklin Templeton launched a tokenized money market fund on the network. This isn't vaporware. These are real institutions committing real capital to Stellar infrastructure in 2026.

XLM is the native utility token of the Stellar network, used to pay transaction fees, maintain account reserves, and facilitate multi-asset swaps through Stellar's built-in decentralized exchange. Every transaction on the network touches XLM — making it structurally central to everything Stellar does.

From remittances to tokenized assets and central bank digital currency pilots, Stellar's real-world adoption is accelerating.
